title: Vegan German Hash
description: A hearty and flavorful vegan German hash made with crispy potatoes and onions, perfect for a quick breakfast or brunch.
instructions: 2. Peel and dice the potatoes into small cubes.
3. Heat the vegan oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
4. Add the diced onion and cook until it's translucent.
5. Add the hash browns and cook until they're crispy.
6. Add the diced potatoes and cook until they're tender.
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
8. Transfer the hash to a baking dish and top with chopped parsley.
9. Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes.
